title: Nearness is still available, even when you feel small.
summary: The shabad names the humble servant as held close. Smallness is not the same thing as abandonment.
takeaway: Do not read your current weakness as distance from care.
lifeApplication: When insecurity rises, answer it with nearness instead of self-attack.

source.shortMeaning: Praise and nearness belong together in the life of the humble servant.
source.lifeApplication: You do not need status to be held close.

evidence.coreClaim: Praise and nearness belong together in the life of the humble servant.
evidence.turn: Nearness is received in humility, not built out of status.
evidence.practicalImplication: When insecurity rises, answer it with nearness instead of self-attack.
